items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Ray and I were good friends.

ctx.x: : But she sang with Artie Shaw.
She made this record with him. She sang -- she went out on the road and sang, I remember. Jack was you know, and Ray Coniff was in the band. Ray and I were
good friends. I got him to do a lot of work with us. So then let's see, I ran into O'Keefe on the street, and he asked me if I would --
